adaptations.pe_binding: /* PE-Reborn: no trusted_apps carveouts, as in the OS3.0.8.0 firmware. */
adaptations.reason: The stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM firmware (vendor_boot Cape DTBs) no longer reserves trusted_apps_region@ea000000 (57 MiB) or trusted_apps_ext_region@ed900000 (59 MiB); its other 54 reserved-memory regions match this source exactly. No node or driver of our kernel references trusted_apps_mem or trusted_apps_ext_mem, so keeping them only withholds about 116 MiB of RAM from Linux under the OS3 TrustZone.

The stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM firmware (vendor_boot Cape DTBs) uses a newer memory-dump table: a 48 MiB mem_dump_region instead of 52 MiB, no CPU/L3/LLCC/GEMNOC scan-dump entries and the fsm_data, osm_reg and pcu_reg entries. The table is read by the TrustZone/SDI crash-dump firmware, which is the OS3 firmware on the device, so it is taken from stock: 97 entries in stock order with stock dump ids and sizes.

In the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot the ADSP and CDSP PAS nodes take a sixth interrupt, bit 7 of their SMP2P slave-kernel input named shutdown-ack, through which the OS3 DSP firmware acknowledges a graceful shutdown; drivers/remoteproc/qcom_sysmon.c of our kernel requests it by that name.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot registers the sensors protection-domain restart on SLPI, where mondrian's sensors run (remoteproc-slpi), not on ADSP; drivers/char/adsprpc.c of our kernel reads both properties.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot votes CX per GPU power level (qcom,cx-level, read by drivers/gpu/msm/adreno.c); frequencies and GX levels already equal stock. Without it CX is under-voted where the GX level is below the CX corner stock requests (e.g. 710 MHz: GX 224, CX NOM).
the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot makes the qseecom CMA heap uncached (qcom,uncached-heap, read by drivers/dma-buf/heaps/qcom_dt_parser.c).

adaptations.pe_binding: /* PE-Reborn: U1/U2 entry allowed, as in OS3.0.8.0. */
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot no longer disables USB3 U1/U2 entry on the DWC3 core (drivers/usb/dwc3/core.c).

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot gives the USB3/DP combo PHY a seventh clock, ref_clk = GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN, which gates the 38.4 MHz reference its PLL sequence uses; our phy-msm-ssusb-qmp.c enables an optional ref_clk and our gcc-waipio.c registers GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN for Cape.

adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot programs the USB3/DP combo PHY with Qualcomm's newer sequence: the QSERDES PLL runs from the 38.4 MHz CLKREF (CMN_CONFIG_1 0x04, DEC_START 0x104, DIV_FRAC 0x5D555 for both modes, the same ~9998 MHz VCO as the 19.2 MHz x4 setting of the source) with matching SSC steps, and the RX UCDR gain, RX equalizer modes and signal-detect level are retuned. Our phy-msm-ssusb-qmp.c applies the same <offset value delay> triplets terminated by 0xffffffff, so the stock register values are used in our format.
